text:
Lara Patel: Quick FYI — API ref for POST /v1/embeddings still shows the single-object example ("input": "..."). We should update examples + Python SDK snippet to show batching (array) and note the old shape was accepted for a while.
Tom Nguyen: Ack, saw a user report. Which files are wrong?
Lara Patel: docs/openapi/embeddings.yml -> example.request.body and docs/snippets/python/embeddings_example.py. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 (draft).
Praneet Iyer: The Python snippet uses client.embeddings.input = "single string" — our SDK actually accepts both but the API expects "inputs" for batch. Suggest changing snippet to:```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-1", inputs=["s1", "s2"])
print(resp.data)
```
Maria Gomez: We should add a migration note in the API ref: "Old single-input shape accepted for compatibility; prefer array 'inputs' for batching and lower latency per-request accounting." Also add a short example for curl showing JSON array.
ci-bot: Lint error in PR #812: docs/openapi/embeddings.yml: example.request.body does not match schema (expected array vs object) at line 42.
docs-bot: Heads-up — deploy preview failed due to OpenAPI schema mismatch (see CI link in PR).
Tom Nguyen: I'll take the openapi fix + update the curl example. Plan: change example.request.body to
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-1",
  "inputs": ["The quick brown fox", "jumped over the lazy dog"]
}
```
and update the python snippet as Praneet suggested.
Lara Patel: Can you also add a tiny paragraph under Embeddings -> Request shape: "Batching: use 'inputs' array. Single-string 'input' is deprecated in examples but still accepted for compatibility." Keep it short.
Tom Nguyen: Will do. Assigning to me, targeting EOD. @Maria can you add the migration blurb and a one-line note in the SDK changelog?
Maria Gomez: Yep, will add changelog entry and LINK to migration note in the docs.
Praneet Iyer: Minor nit — update examples in go and js snippets too, they currently pass 'input' as string in 2 spots. I can search/replace after Tom pushes.
Lara Patel: Thanks all. After PR updates, re-run CI. If the OpenAPI example still fails, we might need to bump the example schema type to array in the generator tests as well.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #812.
Tom Nguyen: Pushed fix for openapi + python + curl. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812/files
Praneet Iyer: Reviewed and left one comment about docstring wording. Small.
Maria Gomez: Merged after CI green. I'll follow up with the changelog PR. :shipit:
Lara Patel: Great — thanks everyone. We'll watch support for any residual user confusion and add an FAQ line if needed.
